events.quote: I will raised this again at, I guess, ACDE in one and a half weeks, by the decision of ACDT that we will remove this EIP from Glamsterdam.
events.note: ACDT reached consensus to remove EIP-7610 from Glamsterdam; jochem-brouwer to raise formally at ACDE in ~1.5 weeks for final decision. Geth and Reth already skip the affected tests. Confidence medium because the facilitator explicitly defers the formal decision to ACDE.

events.quote: In Hegota, we should include that EIP that bumps the NOSS for those accounts, and just finish with this.
events.note: draganrakita proposed EIP-8253 (nonce bump for 28 special mainnet accounts) for Hegota; jochem-brouwer agreed this was the preferred path alongside removing EIP-7610 from Glamsterdam. No formal vote taken on this call; confidence medium.
